ev.q: Estimates of vaccine efficacy (VE) came from three studies
Two economic studies assessed RZV use (versus no vaccination)
On October 20, 2021, the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices recommended 2 RZV doses
Five studies in four immunocompromised groups evaluated herpes zoster as an outcome

methods_quotes.q: ACIP used the Evidence to Recommendations Framework and the Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE) approach
The level of certainty for prevention of herpes zoster and occurrence of SAEs was type 2 (moderate).
